newsitem.title: USA: MSU Corp, Zilog in Internet pact.
newsitem.headline: MSU Corp, Zilog in Internet pact.

text.p: MSU Corp Tuesday said it has entered into a joint venture agreement with Zilog Inc to develop and manufacture chipsets for Television Internet set-top appliances.
Financials details of the agreement were not disclosed.
Under the agreement, Zilog is incorporating MSU's Internet Service Processor technology into its core library, MSU said.

Campbell, California-based Zilog previously announced it formed an Internet Appliance Division which is responsible for building television Internet access devices incorporating chipsets based around MSU's technology.
